portInfo.description: Canaveral Port Authority publishes arrival guides for seven passenger terminals in Cape Canaveral, FL 32920. North-side terminals use Charles Rowland Drive (Exit 54A); south-side terminals use Discovery Road / Christopher Columbus Drive (Exit 54B). Parking is adjacent to each terminal; ship schedules and assigned terminals can change — confirm with your cruise line before embarkation.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: From Orlando International Airport (MCO), the port authority cites about 45 minutes via S.R. 528 East to Exit 54A (north terminals) or 54B (south terminals). Parking is adjacent; terminal assignment can change—confirm with your cruise line.
